verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev has major SDK versions (v3, v4) and documents an end-of-life notice: v3 is EOL, 4.5.0 is the last version that supports v3 tasks, and users should migrate to v4. The changelog also shows deprecation warnings, such as for Node.js 21. However, nothing in the pack shows a formal deprecation policy with notice periods or support windows, or versioned management/REST API endpoints. A community report says the v3→v4 transition felt rushed, with some docs still showing deprecated v3 code. Missing for 10: a documented formal deprecation policy with timelines, explicit API versioning for the HTTP/management API, and published versioned API specs (OpenAPI probes returned 404).
